description:
A simple program to monitor your network/data usage. Made for the average windows user.

OpenNetMeter monitors your network speed and data usage. It shows the current session's usage, the data usage for today, and detailed usage for any period up to the past 60 days. A mini widget can be placed over the taskbar to display the network speed.
- Replaced the previous graphing approach with a custom-drawn speed chart for more control and cleaner rendering
- Added a weekly trend card to the summary view
- Added sortable table controls and cleaner stat row components
- Added search about process online to the summary and history tables
- Added fallback icons when a process icon cannot be loaded
- Fixed Windows freezes during high-throughput network capture
- Fixed access-denied and race-condition issues while loading process icons
- Fixed repeated task scheduler errors on repeated app launches
- Fixed UI update dispatch issues for summary values when network state changes
- Fixed startup issues after reconnects and history profile reloads
- Fixed SQLite cleanup before deleting usage data
- Fixed mini-widget position persistence and restoration
- Fixed recovery of windows that were moved off-screen
- Fixed default settings for the mini-widget transparency slider
- Improved database error handling and startup robustness
- Cleaned up the installer and removed the unnecessary .NET runtime compatibility gate
- Refined theme colors and light-mode styling
- Improved summary/history table wrapping for long process names
- Updated DatePicker styling and visual polish
- Adjusted main window sizing and general UI spacing
- Improved graph readability with Y-axis labeling and text scaling
- Continued migration toward the Avalonia-based app structure
- Improved tray, widget, and overall app lifecycle behavior
- Updated packaging and build flow for the Avalonia-published release
